title: Systematic Biases in LLM Simulations of Debates
reasoning: The paper investigates political bias and opinion convergence in LLM-simulated debates. While some of the debate topics (e.g., racism, gun violence) have moral dimensions, the research focus is on behavioral conformity to model-inherent social biases rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or specific ethical or moral frameworks.
